plotEn:
In 1999, Giovanna Ferretti lives in Albinia, a small town in Maremma, with her mother Sabrina, a teacher. Having lost her beloved father, Giovanna attends middle school, where her shy, awkward and quiet nature makes her a frequent target of bullying. Her classmates mockingly call her "Giovacca", a derogatory nickname combining her name with the Italian word vacca ("cow"). Her closest friend is Mirko, with whom she spends carefree days, often filming their adventures with a video camera. To cope with the bullying and hardships of school life, Giovanna retreats into her imagination, drawing strength from the memory of her father Sergio. She envisions him as a superhero who advises and protects her, taking on the appearance of Kenshiro from the anime series Fist of the North Star.
One morning, Mirko fails to show up at school. The nervous and evasive behaviour of the teachers and other adults leads Giovanna to suspect that something has happened to him. Determined to find out the truth, she overhears her teacher Alberto discussing with the school principal a certain "note" that Mirko is believed to have left before disappearing.
During a school play, Giovanna overhears one of the bullies insulting Mirko and attacks him, resulting in a collective disciplinary note being issued. This provokes the anger of Ludovica Cardini, a student who has been held back several times and is nicknamed "The Hammer" because of her formidable fighting skills. Ludovica threatens to make Giovanna pay
